channel.title: Abderrazzaq El Abdouni — Notes
channel.description: Short write-ups on how this portfolio is built.

item.title: Why the 404 page is a terminal that takes commands
item.description: Most 404s are a dead end. Mine hands you a shell prompt instead: type help or whoami and the page answers.

item.title: Rendering social cards offline with headless Chrome
item.description: Every share card on this site is a PNG rendered at build time: no screenshot service, no runtime dependency.

item.title: A GitHub strip that never calls the GitHub API
item.description: The about page shows repo stats, yet the browser talks to no third party. A build-time snapshot does the fetching.
